# Versions of: Working with WizPress

1 published version of [Working with WizPress: how the AI operating system for newsrooms, built in Faro, and our open-source trust stack fit together, WizPress doing the production, from the inbox to the draft to the CMS, and our layer making every article carry its own proof, with an evidence vault per story, a behaviour policy per agent, a journalist's signature and signed responses, and a thirty-day pilot with one regional newsroom](../working-with-wizpress.md). The current one is **v1.0.0**.

v1.0.0 is the article as first published. A change to its text (title, abstract or body) is the next minor version, v1.1.0; a change only to its other details (a LinkedIn link, the release it belongs to) is the next patch, v1.0.1. The list is read from the site's git history at every build, so it cannot be edited by hand and cannot leave a version out. Views extracted from an article, such as the Five readers, are not part of its text and do not change its version.
